# sreagent_status_page_component (Resource)

A component on the public status page. Destroying it archives it. Order is managed in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_status_page_component" "api" {
  display_name = "Public API"
  description  = "REST and webhook delivery"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Shown on the public page.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Shown under the name.
- `slo_ids` (List of String) SLOs whose state colours the component.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `position` (Number) The component's place on the page.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_status_page_component.api 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
